area: Your app: its install, its user and its doors
description: One partner service answering one extension point, with the shop's consent. Only a System Manager keeps these records.

fields.description: What this service does. Pick from the list.
fields.label: Extension point

fields.description: What a cashier or a Desk user sees. At most 40 characters.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: When several services answer one extension point, the lower number is asked first.
fields.label: Order

fields.description: remote: the partner's service at the address below. wasm: a partner module in iVendNext.
fields.label: Answered by

fields.description: The admitted module that answers this extension point inside the shop.
fields.label: Partner module

fields.description: The partner's HTTPS address. One signed request per call, and redirects are not followed.
fields.label: Address

fields.description: Shared with the partner to sign each request. Never shown on the till or in an error log.
fields.label: Signing secret

fields.description: Each extension point sets its own default and maximum.
fields.label: Time to answer (seconds)

fields.description: If the service can't be reached: an answer the extension point allows. Empty: its first.
fields.label: When the service is down

fields.description: Some extension points only. Scan: {"event": "scan", "item_groups": ["Restricted"]}; a quantity change: the same with "qty_change". Customer: {"event": "customer_add"} or "customer_select". A partner's code (fulfil): {"item_groups": ["Vouchers"]}.
fields.label: Settings for this extension point

fields.description: Lets a check answer approve. Off by default. Needs a manager, not the cashier, with May Approve a Partner's Check and Retail Override Request write.
fields.label: May ask for a manager's approval

fields.description: For a check that verifies each pack, such as a national track-and-trace service. Off by default. Ticking or clearing it changes what is sent, so tick the consent again.
fields.label: Send each line's lot and serial number

fields.description: Cap on a module's cut, as % of the line after promotions. 0 (default): the module does not run. Set only by a System Manager, never by a package.
fields.label: Most a module may take off a line (%)

The page may answer with sale details

fields.description: Page height as % of the till screen, 40 to 100 (default 100). Tablets show it full height.
fields.label: Height on the till (%)

fields.description: The shop's consent. Each extension point's details show here once ticked. A new address, or a release changing the list, clears it.
fields.label: The shop agrees to send these details to this address
